findings.resolution: Recognize Willington, Follow Action and mapping validation reasons in adapterReason.
Map follow_ and willington_ transaction IDs to their apply tools before undo policy checks.
Record the undo key immediately after recovery initialization, before connection or capability checks.
An exact-key retry with no recorded restore steps checks the applied state and sends the restore.
Register newly created MIDI clips as session-clip so note discovery accepts them as parents.
Confirm floating mapping endpoints and unmapped parameter values with _same_number.
Allow native numeric representation changes for Follow time in Python and host apply/undo; other fields remain exact.
Unmap existing targets before mapping, on both writes and compensation.
Use FOLLOW_ACTION_FIELDS to build the host state revision.
Resolve the rack on its current path and read only its subtree for mapping membership; preview reads playback alone.
Read Follow fields only for Session clips when the provider permits writes.
Include the native item URI in browser identity; identical paths with different URIs fail the load fence.
Reuse device parameter refs for macros already in parameters, deduplicate realtime siblings and resolve separate explicit macro refs.
Prefer the advertised bridge schema for set_clip, retaining the static schema only when unavailable.
The Follow package has no uninstall API. Keep its native code mapped, disable writes on disconnect and reuse the registration on reconnect; uninstall DeviceTools.
